// diagnostic

E1220

`{dep}` uses the `{effect}` effect, which this package's budget doesn't allow.

What

`{dep}` uses the `{effect}` effect, which this package's budget doesn't allow.

Why

An `authority.holds` budget fails the build when any dependency reaches an effect you didn't list; a denied `Panic` row names the stop site.

Fix

For an ordinary effect, add `{effect}` to `authority.holds.allow` or grant it to `{dep}` in `authority.grants`; for deny-only `Panic`, return a fallible result or add facts/`#Pre`/refinement proof.
